description:
Translate with Google and DeepL Translator.

Note: When you trigger the configurable Quick Translate shortcut, this extension sends one virtual Ctrl+C to copy the active text selection, reads that clipboard text, and translates it. It also reads the clipboard when you press Paste, use Ctrl+V in its input, or open the panel with Auto Paste enabled. It copies results back only when you press Copy or enable Auto Copy. Translation requests send text to the selected service (Google or DeepL). Clicking a speaker sends that block (up to 500 characters) to Google Translate for online speech, even when translating with DeepL. Speech requires gst-play-1.0 and MP3 audio support.
name: Fast Translate
